name: obengineer
description: Instrumentation architecture workflows for Codex: analyze a target, write the full instrumentation contract, and render it for customer review.

interface.shortDescription: Instrumentation contracts for Splunk Observability Cloud, Enterprise, and ThousandEyes.
interface.longDescription:
obengineer turns an application into an instrumentation contract a team can implement and a TAM can configure.

It scans the target for what is actually there — which agent initialises and when, what else is collecting the same events, where the account and bus boundaries fall — then writes the full contract: cross-cutting attributes and W3C Baggage propagation, the business-transaction and workflow registry, Collector configuration, per-flow dashboards and detectors, and the attribute dictionary. Every guide ships twice: Markdown for the implementers and a Word document for customer architecture review, rendered from the same source so the two cannot disagree.

How to get started:
1. Install the obengineer plugin.
2. Review and trust the SessionStart hook when Codex prompts you.
3. Try: analyze a target with $instrumentation-analyze, write the contract with $instrumentation-guide, design the baggage contract with $baggage-propagation, or render a deliverable for review with $customer-doc-render.
defaultPrompt: Analyze this application for an instrumentation contract.
Write the instrumentation guide from the accepted analysis.
Render the guide as a customer-review Word document.
